data.body_html:
Choosing between a Marbella yacht charter vs Costa del Sol destinations like Estepona, Sotogrande, or Cabopino comes down to what you value: convenience, exclusivity, scenery, or budget. This guide compares each base on distance from airport, marina facilities, boat availability, local attractions, and typical sea conditions — so you can pick the best starting point for your day on the water.

Why Marbella (Puerto Banús) Leads the Costa del Sol

Puerto Banús is the undisputed hub for luxury boat rentals on the Costa del Sol. It's 60 km from Málaga Airport (45 minutes by car), offers 915 berths, and has over 20 restaurants and shops right on the waterfront. Our fleet of 17 boats — from the Marbella yacht charter Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) to the Ferretti 94 (29 m, 12 pax) — all depart from here. The marina is sheltered, with easy access to the open sea via a 50 m wide channel. Average sea temperature ranges from 16 °C in March to 24 °C in August, making it comfortable for swimming from April to October.

Estepona: Quieter Waters, Fewer Yachts

Estepona Marina, 85 km from Málaga Airport, is a smaller, more relaxed alternative. It has about 400 berths and a handful of charter operators (3–4 vs Marbella's 10+). The coastline here is less developed, with clean beaches and the Sierra Bermeja mountains as a backdrop. If you're looking for a chill day away from the Puerto Banús crowds, Estepona works — but you'll have fewer boat choices, and prices tend to be similar to Marbella's. Our nearest boat to Estepona is the Bandido (11.5 m, 8 pax), but we recommend departing from Puerto Banús and cruising south — it's only 12 NM (30–40 minutes).

Sotogrande: The Polo Coast

Sotogrande is 105 km from Málaga Airport and 30 NM from Gibraltar. It's known for its private villas, golf courses, and polo fields — not the party scene. The marina is modern with 500+ berths, but yacht charter options are limited (2–3 operators). If you want to explore the southernmost part of the Costa del Sol, including views of the African coast, Sotogrande is a good base. However, for variety and value, a Marbella yacht charter that heads south to Sotogrande (24 NM, 1 hour) gives you the best of both worlds.

Cabopino: Small, Family-Friendly, East of Marbella

Cabopino Marina, 15 km east of Marbella, is a tiny port with about 200 berths and a sandy beach. It's popular with families because the water is shallow and the atmosphere is low-key. There are only 1–2 charter operators here, and they typically offer small motorboats (up to 8 m). If you want a larger yacht like the Mangusta 80 (24 m, 12 pax) or the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6 m, 12 pax), you'll need to go to Puerto Banús. Cabopino is a good stop for a lunch break — not a launch point for a luxury charter.

Marbella offers the widest range, from the budget-friendly Dubhe (8 m, 5 pax) to the superyacht Ferretti 94 (29 m, 12 pax). All our charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT — no surprises.

Scenic Highlights: Which Coastline Wins?

Marbella's coastline features the Golden Mile, La Concha mountain, and the exclusive villas of Río Verde. Heading west, you'll pass Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés — small coves perfect for anchoring. Estepona offers the Selwo Aventura park and the historic old town. Sotogrande gives you views of Gibraltar and, on clear days, the Rif Mountains of Morocco. Cabopino has dunes and a nature reserve. For sheer variety in a single day, a Marbella yacht charter lets you visit all these spots — you can cover 50 NM in 8 hours on a boat like the Pershing 46 (14 m, 10 pax).

Which Destination Should You Choose?

Pick Marbella (Puerto Banús) if you want the largest fleet, best nightlife, and most charter flexibility. Choose Estepona for a quieter day on the water with fewer crowds. Opt for Sotogrande if you're based near Gibraltar or want to explore the southern coast. Cabopino is best for a short, low-budget family outing. No matter your choice, we can arrange a boat from our fleet — just contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on any boat not listed in our Tier A or B packages.
